reading.body:
Percheron DC is one of four facilities in Morrow County attributed to Rowan Green Data LLC, a company with no reachable corporate website and no independent published description of its properties. The facility's capacity in megawatts is not published, and no secondary source independent of the operator describes it. This means no basis exists to assess what role it plays in available power or rack density for AI workloads.

Oregon has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which only 8 publish their capacity figures to totaling 156.6 megawatts. Percheron DC ranks ninth by published MW in the state, which indicates the registry has identified facilities but cannot place it in the state's infrastructure hierarchy without a published figure. Morrow County itself hosts substantial commercial data center development, including a reported Amazon plan from 2022, but Percheron DC does not appear in public records of that build-out.

For a reader evaluating whether this campus matters to AI scaling, the absence of published capacity, an operator website, or independent verification makes it impossible to determine. The facility exists as a coordinate and a name. Without capacity data or grid connection details, it cannot be assessed against the constraint that binds AI expansion in the region: the power available to run accelerators.
